{{Quote|That's an interesting weapon you have here. Kinda rare isn't it?"<br />"Yeah, it is kinda rare, sort of like that sphere over your shoulder... interested in a trade?|The thief with Kyle Katarn|<ref name="RA" />}}
A '''female thief''' operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. 

==History==
That individual operated as a [[thief/Legends|thief]]<ref name="RA" /> and [[bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="DFRA audio drama credits">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]] casting credits</ref> During her exploits her left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] was destroyed, and replaced it with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] one; she owned a [[Remote/Legends|remote]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was equipped with a blade.<ref name="RA" /> 

By [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] she operated on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]; at one point, she spotted the [[Kyle Katarn]] walking about the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Barons Hed]], and noticed [[Qu Rahn's lightsaber|his lightsaber]] hanging from his [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="RA" /> 

Katarn was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and fledgling [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and had already sensed that someone tailed him as he walked along the [[Rimmer's Alley]]; being a renegade former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]], he tried not to draw attention from Imperials or [[bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] but had neglected covering the [[lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], a rare sight around the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="RA" /> 

The woman confronted Katarn in a residential area near the alley, greeted him politley, and immediately pointed out the interesting weapon he wore. As a response, Katarn proposed to trade it with her remote, and right then prompted a shootout between the two; it was a tenth of a [[standard second]] after his shot struck her [[Throat/Legends|neck]], when hers missed him. She fell gurgling.<ref name="RA" /> 

After her [[Death/Legends|death]], her remote activated. Katarn then used his lightsaber to destroy her remote.<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You looking for something, citizen? Maybe I can help.|The thief trying to approach Kyle Katarn|<ref name="RA" />}}
By nature, the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] was attractive by [[Human/Legends|human]] standards, but her beauty was destroyed when she replaced her lost left eye with a cybernetic device. Her deep voice had a husky timbre.<ref name="RA" />

The woman did not have difficulty to focus on a lightsaber worn by one stranger among the crowd of Rimmer's Alley. In hopes of selling it for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], she followed him to claim the rare artifact.<ref name="RA" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|A girl has to be careful walking these streets. Barons Hed is a dangerous place.|The thief about her remote|<ref name="DFRA audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The woman wore a cybernetic eye to replace her lost one; it consisted of a turret with three lenses, whirring as it rotated. She was armed with a pair of [[blaster/Legends|blasters]]. She was supported by a personal remote that hovered above her shoulder; once activated, it produced a spike of eight [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]]. It was programmed to attack its owner's aggressor, even after he would kill her, as relatiation.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The woman appeared first in ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'' and is not given a name; in the narration Kyle Katarn perceives her as a "would-be thief". 

In the novella, Katarn shoots first once he realises her purpose to mug him, afraid that she might have others with her; in the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio dramatization]] her lines are more, and begins to be clearly menacing, moving for her blaster(s); Kyle warns her, before killing her with Rahn's lightsaber. 

She is voiced by [[Wendy Easton]], credited as "Female Bounty Hunter".
